mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.3pp within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies anticipate lower revenues.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 2% YoY) signals a stable monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors benefit from predictable economic conditions.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL growth was below 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate economic slowdown.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE rose and PAYEMS fell simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening consumer demand and labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate broader economic weakness.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST declined by more than 10% and UNRATE rose by more than 0.2pp within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and a simultaneous decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate strong corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2pp within a month.
